name: zvideo_dd_verify_surface_state_locking
description: zVideo_dd::VerifySurfaceStateLocking gates a surface-lock verifier provider call on flag 0x20 and passes the recovered 0x28-byte argument record with caller context.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw display/mode-management source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9160 validates fastcall ECX as callerContext, the 0x20 flag gate on g_zVideo_SurfaceLockVerifyFlags, a 0x28-byte stack argument block with size at offset 0 and callerContext at offset 0x1c, and provider VerifySurfaceState dispatch through slot 0x10.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a9160 has no warnings and matches the implemented flag gate, verifier provider call, and zVideo_dd::ReportError(hresult, zvid_dd.c, 0x61a) on nonzero provider result.
The native smoke verifies the disabled flag path makes no provider call and the enabled flag path passes a sizeof(zVideo_SurfaceLockVerifyArgs) record with the caller context preserved.
